detail: Full summary: Parallel-stream dogfood observation: teammate blackboard writes land in the main checkout's .twining while code edits stay in worktrees — so the shared blackboard mtime keeps advancing past the controller's last record, which re-arms the stop hook for the controller even when the controller made no new code changes. Worth watching as a v2 multi-agent ergonomics issue (stop-hook sentinel vs shared-state mtime).
